SELECT a.CLOSE_PRICE as price FROM MST_SHARE_PRICE a INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT c ON a.SHARES_ID = c.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.SHARES_ID = #{secId} and a.DEAL_DATE = to_date(#{date},'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1

SELECT a.CLOSE_PRICE as price FROM INTERF_STOCK_QUOTE a INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT c ON a.STOCK_COOD = c.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.STOCK_COOD = #{secId} and a.TRADE_DATE = to_date(#{date},'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1

with temp as (SELECT distinct TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd WHERE TRADE_ID =#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR TOTLE_TRADE_ID =#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union all SELECT distinct TOTLE_TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd WHERE TRADE_ID =#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR TOTLE_TRADE_ID =#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union all SELECT #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as TRADE_ID FROM DUAL ) SELECT
, CASE WHEN PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME IS NULL THEN RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE.PTL_BAG_NAME ELSE PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME END PORTFOLIO_NAME, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME ASSET_NAME FROM RSK_ISUP_TRIAL LEFT JOIN RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR ON RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.IND_ID = RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR.IND_ID LEFT JOIN RSK_ISUP_TRIAL_CLS ON RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.TRADE_ID = RSK_ISUP_TRIAL_CLS.TRADE_ID AND RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.SEQ_NO=RSK_ISUP_TRIAL_CLS.SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.PORTFOLIO_ID=PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE ON RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.PORTFOLIO_ID=RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE.PTL_BAG_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.ASSET_CODE=FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID WHERE RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.TRADE_ID in (select TRADE_ID from temp) AND RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.SEQ_NO IN ( SELECT max(SEQ_NO) FROM RSK_ISUP_TRIAL WHERE RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.TRADE_ID in (select TRADE_ID from temp) group by PORTFOLIO_ID )

SELECT (SELECT FSCR.SCALE from FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO FSCR where FSCR.FINPROD_ID =#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FSCR.VDATE <= #{date} AND FSCR.MDATE >= #{date} and rownum =1) scale, NVL(NVL(NVL(NVL(SBMCI.MORE_CONVRATE,SBMCI2.MORE_CONVRATE),NVL(SBMCICP.MORE_CONVRATE,SBMCICP2.MORE_CONVRATE)),1), #{MORE_CONVRATE}) as tandardRate FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SSAI LEFT JOIN (select distinct pci.ACCT_NO,sci.ACCT_NAME, T.CUSTOMER_ID from STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pci ON pci.ACCT_NO = sci.ACCT_NO AND pci.CCY = sci.CCY AND pci.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN(select msd.SALE_DEPID SALE_DEPID, mci.CUSTOMER_ID from mst_sale_department msd left join mst_customer_info mci on mci.CUSTOMER_ID = msd.BROKER_ID where mci.IS_BROKER = 'Y' ) T on T.SALE_DEPID = sci.OWN_DEPT where pci.ACCT_TYPE = 'A07')TEMP2 ON SSAI.TRD_ACCT_ID = TEMP2.ACCT_NO AND SSAI.TRD_ACCT_ID = #{acctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN (SELECT BROKER_ID, FINPROD_ID,
ACCT_NO,
START_DATE, END_DATE, MORE_CONVRATE FROM STD_BOND_MORE_CONVRATE_INFO WHERE END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND to_date(START_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{date} AND to_date(END_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= #{date} ) SBMCI
ON TEMP2.CUSTOMER_ID = SBMCI.BROKER_ID AND (SBMCI.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or SSAI.TRD_ACCT_ID = SBMCI.ACCT_NO)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BROKER_ID, FINPROD_ID,
ACCT_NO,
START_DATE, END_DATE, MORE_CONVRATE FROM STD_BOND_MORE_CONVRATE_INFO WHERE END_DATE IS NULL AND to_date(START_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{date} ) SBMCI2
ON TEMP2.CUSTOMER_ID = SBMCI2.BROKER_ID AND ( SBMCI2.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or SSAI.TRD_ACCT_ID = SBMCI2.ACCT_NO)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BROKER_ID, FINPROD_ID,
ACCT_NO,
START_DATE, END_DATE, MORE_CONVRATE FROM STD_BOND_MORE_CONVRATE_INFO WHERE END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND to_date(START_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{date} AND to_date(END_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= #{date} ) SBMCICP
ON ('BROKER' = SBMCICP.FINPROD_ID or 'BROKER' = SBMCICP.ACCT_NO) AND TEMP2.CUSTOMER_ID = SBMCICP.BROKER_ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BROKER_ID, FINPROD_ID,
ACCT_NO,
START_DATE, END_DATE, MORE_CONVRATE FROM STD_BOND_MORE_CONVRATE_INFO WHERE END_DATE IS NULL AND to_date(START_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{date} ) SBMCICP2
ON ('BROKER' = SBMCICP2.FINPROD_ID or 'BROKER' = SBMCICP2.ACCT_NO) AND TEMP2.CUSTOMER_ID = SBMCICP2.BROKER_ID
where SSAI.TRD_ACCT_ID =#{acctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1

SELECT DISTINCT BUSINESS_MODEL AS businessModel, PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, FINPROD_ID finprodId FROM ( SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID, BUSINESS_MODEL FROM ( SELECT b.PORTFOLIO_ID, a.FINPROD_ID, a.BUSINESS_MODEL, ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.TRADE_ID ORDER BY a.TRADE_DATE DESC ) rn FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL a LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD b ON a.TRADE_ID = b.TRADE_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.TRADE_DATE <= to_date( #{ cdate, jdbcType = VARCHAR }, 'yyyy-MM-dd' ) ) WHERE rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID, BUSINESS_MODEL FROM ( SELECT b.PORTFOLIO_ID, a.FINPROD_ID, a.BUSINESS_MODEL, ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.TRADE_ID ORDER BY a.TRADE_DATE DESC ) rn FROM TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL a LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL_ADD b ON a.TRADE_ID = b.TRADE_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.TRADE_DATE = to_date( #{ cdate, jdbcType = VARCHAR }, 'yyyy-MM-dd' ) ) WHERE rn = 1 ) TMP WHERE TMP.PORTFOLIO_ID =#{ portfolioId,jdbcType = VARCHAR } AND TMP.FINPROD_ID =#{ finprodId,jdbcType = VARCHAR }
